name: Mana Community - DG Generator Fuel Anomaly & Maintenance Predictor

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const prompt = "You are an autonomous AI engineering specialist for Mana Community smart infrastructure. You analyze diesel generator run hours, fuel dip measurements, refill invoices, and burn rates (liters/hour). Detect diesel pilferage, sensor leakage, and calculate 250-hour B-Check service maintenance countdowns.

Analyze the input payload securely:
__DATA__

Respond strictly with valid JSON conforming to this schema:
{
  "generatorId": "DG-500KVA-01",
  "anomalySeverity": "NORMAL",
  "fuelConsumptionLitersPerHour": 28.4,
  "expectedBurnRateRange": "25 - 32 L/hr",
  "theftOrLeakageRisk": "LOW",
  "hoursRemainingToBCheck": 42.5,
  "projectedBCheckDate": "2026-12-14",
  "alerts": [],
  "maintenanceDirectives": [
    "Check lube oil clarity and change primary fuel filter at 250h threshold",
    "Inspect radiator coolant level and belt tension"
  ]
}

Rules:
- anomalySeverity must be one of: "NORMAL", "SUSPECTED_PILFERAGE", "SENSOR_ANOMALY", "CRITICAL_OVERCONSUMPTION".
- Return pure JSON only, no markdown wrapping, no extra keys.";
return [{ json: { prompt: prompt.replace("__DATA__", JSON.stringify(item, null, 2)), originalInput: item } }];
